01海事安全与地缘政治 · 2026年11月14日

联合国：霍尔木兹海峡冲突已致25名海员遇难，伊朗再称两艘油轮触雷

UN: 25 Seafarers Killed Around Strait of Hormuz; Iran Claims Two More Tankers Hit Mines

At least 25 seafarers have been killed in and around the Strait of Hormuz since the US-Israeli war on Iran began in February, UN Assistant Secretary-General Khaled Khiari told the Security Council on 13 November. The IMO tracked 136 vessel security incidents from 1 March to 11 November, with 35 in October — the worst month yet — and 10 already in November. Khiari warned current shipping arrangements are "costly, unpredictable and unsafe" and urged full restoration of navigation. Hours later, Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed early on Saturday that two more oil tankers, one a supertanker, had struck mines and caught fire, without naming any vessel and with no independent confirmation.

联合国负责中东事务的助理秘书长哈立德·希亚里13日向安理会通报，自今年2月美以与伊朗开战以来，霍尔木兹海峡及周边已至少有25名海员遇难；国际海事组织统计3月1日至11月11日共发生136起涉船安全事件，其中10月35起为冲突以来单月最高，11月已有10起。希亚里警告当前航运安排"代价高昂、不可预测且不安全"，呼吁全面恢复正常通航。与此同时，伊朗革命卫队14日凌晨再称两艘油轮（一艘为超级油轮）在海峡触雷爆炸起火，但未公布船名，也无独立来源证实。

注：联合国简报文字记录为134起，半岛电视台报道为136起，相差2起；本报采用半岛电视台的136起并在此注明差异。Note: The UN briefing transcript records 134 incidents against Al Jazeera's 136 — a difference of two; this paper uses Al Jazeera's figure and flags the discrepancy here.

02海事安全与地缘政治 · 2026年11月15日

新奥尔良撞船事故后续：法院下令扣押肇事油轮，航行数据记录仪已找回

New Orleans Collision Aftermath: Court Orders Tanker Arrested; Voyage Data Recorder Recovered

The US National Transportation Safety Board said on 14 November it has recovered the voyage data recorder from the bitumen tanker Atlantic Asphalt, which struck and sank the river cruise ship American Heritage, and has deployed 16 investigators to the scene; a preliminary report is expected within 24 to 30 days. No one was killed, 32 people were hospitalised and about 100 were pulled from the water; 191 people were on board. The Port of New Orleans sued the tanker's owner and manager on Friday evening, claiming more than $1 million in damage, and a federal judge granted an emergency request to arrest the vessel. Manager OSM Thome said on Saturday the tanker was stable at anchor and cooperating with investigators.

美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）14日表示，已找回撞沉游船的沥青油轮 Atlantic Asphalt 的航行数据记录仪，并派出16名调查员赴现场，初步报告预计24至30天内发布。事故造成32人送医、无人死亡，约100人被从水中救起，船上共191人。另据报道，新奥尔良港13日晚向联邦法院起诉油轮船东与管理公司索赔逾100万美元，首席法官温迪·维特已批准扣押油轮的紧急申请；管理公司 OSM Thome 14日称油轮已稳定锚泊并配合调查。

03集装箱、港口与供应链 · 2026年11月14日

集装箱船加速重返苏伊士运河，赫伯罗特计划2027年初全面恢复红海航线

Container Ships Accelerate Return to Suez Canal; Hapag-Lloyd Plans Full Red Sea Return in Early 2027

An average of 14.8 container ships a day transited the Suez Canal on 1–8 November, the highest monthly pace since November 2023 and about three-quarters of the 19.6-a-day average of January–October 2023, ship-tracking data show. Traffic at Bab el-Mandeb, the Red Sea's southern gate, lagged at 5.1 a day, far below pre-war levels. Hapag-Lloyd said after its third-quarter results on 12 November that it will fully return to the Red Sea and Suez route at the start of 2027. Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd's Gemini network moved an India–Europe loop back through the canal from 4 November, and Evergreen has sent its first ships through in almost three years.

船舶追踪数据显示，11月1日至8日平均每天有14.8艘集装箱船通过苏伊士运河，为2023年11月以来任何月份的最高水平，约为2023年1至10月日均19.6艘的四分之三；但红海南口曼德海峡同期仅日均5.1艘，仍远低于战前水平。赫伯罗特在11月12日公布三季度业绩后表示，将于2027年初全面恢复红海与苏伊士航线；马士基与赫伯罗特的 Gemini 联盟已于11月4日起把一条印度—欧洲航线移回苏伊士，长荣也时隔近三年首派船舶通过运河。

04集装箱、港口与供应链 · 2026年11月14日

Drewry 世界集装箱指数跌2%至4,305美元，跨太平洋与亚欧航线同步走弱

Drewry World Container Index Falls 2% to $4,305 as Transpacific and Asia–Europe Rates Weaken

Drewry's World Container Index fell 2% this week to $4,305 per 40ft container as rates weakened across the Transpacific and Asia–Europe trades. Shanghai–New York dropped 3% to $9,020, its lowest since August, and Shanghai–Los Angeles fell 2% to $7,416, its lowest since September; Shanghai–Rotterdam declined 3% to $3,504, while Shanghai–Genoa held at $4,168. Carriers are tightening capacity, with eight blank sailings announced for next week, and Drewry expects Transpacific rates to fall further next week.

Drewry 世界集装箱指数（WCI）本周下跌2%至每40英尺箱4,305美元，跨太平洋与亚欧航线运价同步走弱。上海至纽约跌3%至9,020美元，为8月以来最低；上海至洛杉矶跌2%至7,416美元，为9月以来最低；上海至鹿特丹跌3%至3,504美元，上海至热那亚持平于4,168美元。船公司正通过停航控制运力，下周已宣布8个停航航次；Drewry 预计跨太平洋运价下周将进一步下跌。

06集装箱、港口与供应链 · 2026年11月14日

荷兰埃姆斯哈文港警告：核电建设计划或拖累港口能源投资

Groningen Seaports Warns Nuclear Plans Could Derail Eemshaven Development

Groningen Seaports has warned that proposals to build two nuclear power stations at Eemshaven in the Netherlands could delay existing port-related energy investments and restrict industrial expansion. An independent study commissioned by the port authority found construction could occupy 70 to 100 hectares in the Oostpolder industrial area for about 15 years — up to a quarter of the land available for new businesses — and siting the reactors on the existing ENGIE power station site could disrupt planned hydrogen infrastructure, raising costs and delaying projects already in development. Redeveloping the ENGIE site could require closing the existing 1.8 GW Eems power station between 2028 and 2031, while the proposed nuclear plants are not expected to generate power before 2040. No final decision has been made on the plants' location.

荷兰格罗宁根港务局警告，在埃姆斯哈文建设两座核电站的方案可能拖延港口现有的能源投资并限制工业扩张。港务局委托的独立研究显示，核电站建设将在约15年内占用 Oostpolder 工业开发区70至100公顷土地，约占可供新企业用地四分之一；若选址于现有 ENGIE 电站地块，还可能打乱已规划的氢能基础设施、推高成本并延误在建项目。研究还指出，改造 ENGIE 地块或需在2028至2031年间关闭现有的1.8吉瓦 Eems 电站，而拟建核电站预计2040年前无法发电；核电站选址尚未最终决定。

05LNG 与天然气 · 2026年11月14日

阿根廷批准18.5亿美元巴伊亚布兰卡液化气出口项目，2030年投产

Argentina Approves $1.85bn Bahía Blanca Liquid Gas Export Project, Due On Stream in 2030

Argentina's economy ministry has approved a $1.85bn investment programme led by Midstream de Gas del Sur to build liquid gas export infrastructure at the Port of Bahía Blanca, granting it tax, customs and foreign-exchange incentives under the country's RIGI large-investment regime. The project includes a 577 km pipeline linking the Tratayén gas production area in Neuquén with General Daniel Cerri near Bahía Blanca, a fractionation plant able to process 90,000 barrels per day, and three 16 km transfer pipelines to storage and export facilities for propane, butane and natural gasoline. Construction began in May 2026, with commercial operations scheduled for February 2030.

阿根廷经济部已批准由 Midstream de Gas del Sur 牵头的18.5亿美元投资计划，在巴伊亚布兰卡港建设液化气出口基础设施，并纳入该国大型投资激励机制（RIGI），享受税收、海关与外汇优惠。项目包括一条577公里管道，把内乌肯省 Tratayén 产气区与巴伊亚布兰卡附近的 General Daniel Cerri 连接起来，以及一座日处理9万桶的分馏厂和三条16公里转运管道，出口丙烷、丁烷与天然汽油。工程已于2026年5月开工，计划2030年2月投入商业运营。

07LNG 与天然气 · 2026年11月14日

卡塔尔 LNG 船 Al-Daayen 抵达巴基斯坦，冬季保供再添一船货

Qatari LNG Carrier Al-Daayen Berths in Pakistan as Winter Supply Build-Up Continues

A Qatari LNG carrier, Al-Daayen, was due to berth at Pakistan GasPort Limited's terminal on Saturday, 14 November, to begin regasification. Pakistan has secured three LNG cargoes for November at 13.37% of Brent, a Petroleum Division official confirmed, with two more cargoes due later in the month to meet sharply rising winter gas demand. Islamabad is also in talks with Qatar for nine December cargoes to ensure uninterrupted supply through the peak winter months.

一艘来自卡塔尔的 LNG 船 Al-Daayen 将于11月14日（周六）抵达巴基斯坦天然气港公司（PGPL）终端开始气化。巴基斯坦石油部门官员证实，本月已锁定三船 LNG，价格为布伦特原油价格的13.37%，11月剩余时间还将再到两船，以应对冬季国内天然气需求大增；巴方还正与卡塔尔接洽12月九船货的供应，以保障冬季高峰期的不间断供应。

08油轮与能源市场 · 2026年11月14日

油价连续第二周下跌，布伦特收于95.84美元，供应过剩压过霍尔木兹风险

Oil Posts Second Straight Weekly Loss; Brent Settles at $95.84 as Supply Surplus Outweighs Hormuz Risk

Brent crude futures settled at $95.84 a barrel on Friday, down about 2.5% on the week for a second straight weekly loss, while US WTI closed at $88.56. Rising OPEC+ output — up 1.96 million barrels a day to 27.16 million in October — and an unexpected 4.66-million-barrel build in US commercial crude inventories outweighed concerns over disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency expects global oil supply to exceed demand. Brent is now about 20% below its late-October high near $118.

布伦特原油期货周五收于每桶95.84美元，全周下跌约2.5%，连续第二周走低；美国 WTI 收于88.56美元，同样周跌约2.5%。尽管霍尔木兹海峡局势持续紧张，OPEC+ 10月产量环比增加196万桶/日至2,716万桶/日、美国商业原油库存意外增加466万桶（预期为减少110万桶），令供应过剩担忧占了上风；国际能源署也预计全球石油供应将超过需求。布伦特已较10月下旬约118美元的高点回落约20%。

注：另有报道称布伦特周五收于95.41美元（HDFC Sky），与路透结算价95.84美元相差0.43美元，疑为不同合约或统计口径；本报采用路透结算价。Note: Another report put Brent's Friday close at $95.41 (HDFC Sky), $0.43 below the Reuters settlement of $95.84 — likely a different contract or basis; this paper uses the Reuters settlement.
